title: BPMN Generator HTTP API — response contract
description: The success-response shape of each POST endpoint in scripts/http-server.js, documented in references/api-reference.md. Validated by .github/scripts/docs-gate.mjs against a response actually produced by the running pipeline — not asserted from memory. Error responses (schema_error / validation_error / diagram_error / profile_error / internal_error) are simpler and covered in prose in api-reference.md, not schematized here.

VisualRefinementOption.description: Request option on POST /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/orchestrate and the MCP tools generate_bpmn and orchestrate_bpmn. Must equal VISUAL_REFINEMENT_OPTION_SCHEMA in scripts/bpmn/visual-refinement.js (fenced by a test).

LayoutSwitchOption.description: Request options bendRule, nodeLabelsAvoidFlows and foreignShapeRepair on POST /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/orchestrate and the MCP tools generate_bpmn and orchestrate_bpmn. Omitted: config.json -> layout.<option>. Must equal LAYOUT_SWITCH_OPTION_SCHEMA in scripts/bpmn/schema-gate.js (fenced by a test).

ViewOption.title: View
ViewOption.description: A view: a small named file that decides how a model is processed (which rule profile, which layout switches, which derivations). It lives outside the model. Every view passes this gate (scripts/shared/view.js) before anything reads it; unknown keys are refused at every level.

ruleProfile.description: A rule profile NAME (resolved inside rules/), never a path.

lanes.description: Lanes formed from the assignments of a format 2.x model: per performer (role), per unit of the performer (unit), per system of the task (system) or none; or the object form { by: "role" | "unit", … }. For units, `level` counts the organigram (partOf) from the top, 1 = units without partOf, and `nested` draws sub-units as lanes inside their parent. For both, `automatic: "lane"` puts every automatic task without performer into a placeholder lane of its own (`automaticName`, default "(automatisch)"); the system view takes the string form only. Absent: a 1.x model keeps its own lanes, a 2.x model gets role lanes. On a 1.x model a view with lanes is refused.

automatic.description: Where an automatic task without performer goes: "neighbour" (default) with its neighbour by the inheritance rule (H03), "lane" into a placeholder lane of its own (H19). Not in the system view.

automaticName.description: The name of that lane in this view; default from scripts/config.json laneFormation.automaticName, "(automatisch)". Only with automatic "lane".

automatic.description: Where an automatic task without performer goes: "neighbour" (default) with its neighbour by the inheritance rule (H03), "lane" into a placeholder lane of its own (H19). Not in the system view.

automaticName.description: The name of that lane in this view; default from scripts/config.json laneFormation.automaticName, "(automatisch)". Only with automatic "lane".

ValidateResponse.description: POST /api/v1/validate — success response. No diagnostics: this endpoint never runs layout.

ImportResponse.description: POST /api/v1/import — success response. `notices` appears only for a diagram generated from a format 2.0 model (origin attributes on bpmn:definitions); the import never refuses.

OrchestrateResponse.description: POST /api/v1/orchestrate — success response. `status` does not currently flip to "diagram_error" here (see api-reference.md) — a caller must check diagnostics.ok separately.

Validation.description: Output of the rule engine (scripts/bpmn/rules.js runRules). Reasons about the Logic-Core graph — never sees a coordinate. See 'validation vs. diagnostics' in api-reference.md. `xmlWarnings` is only present on the runPipeline path (/generate, /orchestrate) — /validate calls the rule engine directly and never produces it.

xmlWarnings.description: Round-trip warnings from re-parsing the generated XML through bpmn-moddle (scripts/bpmn-xml.js validateBpmnXml).

hints.description: Information, never a warning: nothing is wrong, the output shows something the author did not write or a gap in the assignments; hints never fail --strict. runPipeline path only. Lane hints of a format 2.0 model (scripts/bpmn/model-v2.js formLanes) come first: H02 an activity without performer, elements [nodeId]; H03 an automatic activity without performer placed with its neighbour, [nodeId, laneId]; with the view option lanes.automatic "lane" instead H19 an automatic activity without performer placed in the lane "(automatisch)" (or the view's automaticName), [nodeId, laneId]; H04 the unit of the performer not recorded (view unit), [nodeId, actorId]; H05 a lane name over 25 characters, [laneId, actorId] (in the system view the second element is the system id); H06 a process without any performer (in the system view: without any system), no lanes, [processId]; H08 a node without a neighbour with a lane, placed in the placeholder lane (in the system view "(System nicht erhoben)"), [nodeId]; H20 (system view) an activity without a recorded system, placed in the lane "(System nicht erhoben)", [nodeId]. Before them, H09 per catalogue entry the process file's actors, systems or data replace, [actorId, systemId or dataId], then H21 per data item a step uses that has no recorded kind (drawn as a data object), [dataId]. Then one entry per element a view derived (scripts/bpmn/derivations.js): H01 a join gateway and its onward flow, elements [gatewayId, targetId, flowId]. Last, for a model with a valid `language` (scripts/bpmn/naming/index.js namingHints): H12 when the language has no naming conventions here, [] (M01, M05 and M06 are skipped), or H13 when at least 60 % of at least 3 task names fail the declared convention and at least 80 % pass that of another registered language, [], or else H14 once when task names pass M01 only because their first word is not on the verb list (at most 10 distinct words named), []; then, for a supported language, H10 per event whose marker was inferred from its name, [eventId]; then H11 per event whose name gave a marker before a language was declared and gives none or another one under it, [eventId]. A model without a valid `language` gets none of these. Then, for a format 2.x model, H15 when no order of the stacked participants avoids a DI05, elements the flow ids (each named DI05 message ends with ' No order of the participants avoids every crossing.'; the CLI's --strict does not count it). Then, in any format, H16 per label whose text the SVG breaks inside a word that has no blank, hyphen or soft hyphen to break at, elements [the id of the element the label belongs to]; the message names the word(s) and says that a soft hyphen (U+00AD) in the name sets the break point. Then, in any format, H17 per message catcher (a start, intermediate catch or boundary event with the message marker the writer writes, or a receive task, at any depth) that no message flow targets by its own id, in a model with more than one participant (expanded or black-box pool), elements [the catcher's id]. Last, in any format, H18 per label finding, read from the BPMNLabel bounds and waypoints the DI writes (scripts/bpmn/label-check.js): a sequence or message flow whose route runs at least 2 px inside the label box of an event, gateway, data object or store or of another flow (not its own), elements [flowId, ownerId]; an edge label more than 6 px from its own route and more than 10 px nearer to a shape that is neither its source nor its target, [flowId, shapeId]; two labels overlapping or less than 2 px apart, each pair once, [ownerId, ownerId]; the message names the case ('crosses the label of', 'sits nearer to', 'overlaps' / 'is too close to'). Nothing is moved. Hints exist on the generate path only: validate calls (`/api/v1/validate`, `validate_bpmn`) carry no hints.

findings.description: format 2.x runs only: every message of `errors` and `warnings` once more with its code and severity, errors first, then warnings; `message` is the very string in the list it mirrors. Codes: C01-C06, C10, C12-C17, F01, F02, F04, F06 (the `[code] ` prefix of the message), F05 (a `decisions` option failing the Decision-Core schema; the message carries no prefix), the rule ids S/M/P/WF (rule messages carry no prefix). Layout notes in `infos` and `xmlWarnings` get no finding. Absent on format 1.x runs.

Advisory.description: One Optimization Advisory finding (O01-O04, optimize mode only). Field-by-field docs: api-reference.md under POST /api/v1/generate.

Diagnostics.description: Output of the post-layout DI integrity check (scripts/di-check.js checkDiagramIntegrity). Inspects the geometry actually produced — never seen by the rule engine.

ok.description: No ERROR-severity finding. WARNING-severity findings (DI05, DI08, DI09, DI10, DI11) may still be present.

Compliance.description: Output of the compliance agent (scripts/agents/compliance.js) — the rule engine re-run for the orchestrated flow.

findings.description: format 2.0 models only (absent on 1.x): the verdict of scripts/bpmn/validate.js validateModel as objects, every severity — the catalogue errors (C01-C07, C12-C17, F01, F06) alone, else the rule findings (S/M/P/WF ids, WF_OR included).
